estimatedValuesSource.name: Open-Meteo Historical Forecast API
estimatedValuesSource.description: Gridded past forecasts, not NEA observations. Fields listed in estimatedValues replace missing station observations only; S107 coordinates come from NEA October 2026 station metadata.

nearbyStationValuesSource.description: Rainfall substitutions use the closest station with a complete verified daily reading; values are not measurements at the target station.
